# Repo-owned gtest-parallel snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [google/gtest-parallel](https://github.com/google/gtest-parallel) at commit `96f4f904922f9bf66689e749c40f314845baaac8`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all nine original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original Apache-2.0 `LICENSE` is retained in full. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The project uses this optional Python runner for tests; it is not an MM7 app runtime input. Other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
